# SignerOptions

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The options of a signer criterion (#31).

A signer criterion matches if any signature that takes part satisfies
it. A signature takes part when its status is accepted, it comes from
the chosen source and has the chosen index, and it meets every
constraint here (`signed_after`, `countersigned`, `min_key_bits` and
`disallowed_algorithms`). A constraint whose fact is unknown makes that
signature's result unknown, never a match.

Appears at: `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/all/criterion/signer`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/any/criterion/signer`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/not/not/criterion/signer`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/not/criterion/signer`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/criterion/signer`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/any/all/criterion/signer`, and more.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accept_status` | array of [`SignerStatus`](types.md#signerstatus) | no |  | 1 to 6 items | 1.0.0 | The signature statuses that can match. Unset means `valid`, `valid_expired_timestamped` and `catalog_signed`. `digest_mismatch` cannot be listed: see `allow_digest_mismatch`. Validation warns when a rule that lets an object run accepts any other status. |
| `allow_digest_mismatch` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Let a signature whose signed digest does not match the file take part: the file was changed after it was signed. Validation always warns about it. Unset means `false`. |
| `component` | [`SubjectComponent`](types.md#subjectcomponent) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Only for `signer.publisher`: the part of the leaf subject compared. Unset means `cn`. |
| `countersigned` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The signature must carry an RFC 3161 timestamp that verifies. Unset means `false`: no requirement. |
| `disallowed_algorithms` | array of [`DigestAlgorithm`](types.md#digestalgorithm) | no |  | at most 6 items | 1.0.0 | The signature must use none of these digest algorithms, in the file digest, the signer information or any certificate of its chain. |
| `min_key_bits` | integer | no |  | 1 to 16384; format `uint32` | 1.0.0 | Every key in the signature's chain must be at least this strong, in RSA-equivalent bits (see `crate::facts::SignerDetails::min_key_bits`). |
| `position` | [`TbsPosition`](types.md#tbsposition) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Only for `signer.tbs_hash`: where in the chain the certificate must be. Unset means `any`. |
| `signature_index` | integer | no |  | 0 to 63; format `uint8` | 1.0.0 | Only the signature at this index, counted from 0 among the signatures of `source`: 0 is the primary embedded signature, 1 the first nested one. Unset means any signature. |
| `signed_after` | string | no |  | 1 to 64 characters | 1.0.0 | A trusted timestamp must show that the signature was made at or after this instant: an RFC 3339 time with an offset, such as `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`. A signature with no trusted timestamp is unknown. |
| `source` | [`SignerSource`](types.md#signersource) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Where the signature must come from. Unset means `any`. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
